text: Local Search: Feasible Solutions and Neighborhoods @ Feasible solution o A solution that satisfies all problem constraints o Belongs to the feasible set F @ Neighbouring solution o A feasible solution obtained from the current one o Generated by applying a local modification @ Local modifications o Small, structured changes to the current solution o Preserve feasibility by design o Define the neighborhood structure Key idea Local search algorithms move through the feasible space by repeatedly applying local modifications to generate neighbouring feasible solutions.
